facts_for_explanation.what_it_is: A penalty of 5% of the tax that was still unpaid 30 days after the payment deadline. Further 5% penalties follow at 6 months and 12 months if tax is still unpaid.
points: Interest is also charged on tax paid late. Interest can't be appealed, only the penalty.
Unpaid payments on account become part of the tax due by 31 January, so they can lead to a late payment penalty too.
facts_for_explanation.payment_deadline: 31 January after the end of the tax year

extended_appeal_date_on_letter.rule: If page 2 of the notice says 'We've given you more time to appeal your penalty. You now have until [date]', use that date as the appeal deadline instead of notice date + 30 days.
extended_appeal_date_on_letter.phrase: We've given you more time to appeal your penalty
extended_appeal_date_on_letter.source: Confirmed from real HMRC letters supplied by Eduard, 28 Oct 2026
